class.name: Streamline
class.brief_description: NVIDIA Streamline interface (DLSS, DLSS Frame Generation, Reflex).
class.description: Global NVIDIA Streamline interface. Streamline provides NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution and DLAA through [constant Viewport.SCALING_3D_MODE_DLSS], DLSS Frame Generation through [member Viewport.frame_generation], and NVIDIA Reflex low latency mode with PC Latency (PCL) markers. Streamline is only compiled into Windows builds ([code]use_streamline=yes[/code], the default) and is only initialized for the D3D12 and Vulkan rendering drivers. DLSS needs [code]sl.interposer.dll[/code], [code]sl.common.dll[/code], [code]sl.dlss.dll[/code] and [code]nvngx_dlss.dll[/code] from the NVIDIA Streamline SDK next to the executable; Frame Generation and Reflex also need [code]sl.dlss_g.dll[/code], [code]nvngx_dlssg.dll[/code], [code]sl.reflex.dll[/code] and [code]sl.pcl.dll[/code]. Frame Generation, Reflex and PCL are only loaded for the running project, never in the editor or project manager. In every other case, all capabilities are reported as unavailable. [codeblock] var sl = Engine.get_singleton("Streamline") if Engine.has_singleton("Streamline") else null if sl and sl.get_capability(0): # STREAMLINE_CAPABILITY_DLSS get_viewport().scaling_3d_mode = Viewport.SCALING_3D_MODE_DLSS if sl.get_capability(1): # STREAMLINE_CAPABILITY_DLSS_G get_viewport().frame_generation = true [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] Ray Reconstruction and NIS are not part of this build; their capabilities are always reported as unavailable.

method.name: get_capability
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if Streamline reports the capability as supported on the current rendering device. See [enum StreamlineCapabilityType] for types. The value is known once the rendering device is created (i.e. from any script's [code]_ready()[/code]).

method.name: get_frame_generation_max_frames
method.description: Returns the maximum number of frames DLSS Frame Generation can generate per rendered frame on this GPU: [code]1[/code] (2x, RTX 40 series) or [code]3[/code] (up to 4x, DLSS Multi Frame Generation on RTX 50 series). Returns [code]0[/code] if frame generation is unavailable or has not been started yet (the value is queried when frame generation is first enabled).

method.name: get_frame_generation_status
method.description: Returns the last DLSS Frame Generation status reported by Streamline while frame generation was active, as a bitmask of [code]sl::DLSSGStatus[/code] failure flags: [code]1[/code] resolution too low, [code]2[/code] Reflex not running, [code]4[/code] unsupported back buffer format, [code]8[/code] invalid constants. [code]0[/code] means everything works (or frame generation never ran). Failures are also printed as errors.

method.name: get_parameter
method.description: Returns the value requested with [method set_parameter] (or from the project settings once the rendering device is created). [constant STREAMLINE_PARAM_DLSS_RR_PRESET] returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_reflex_mode
method.description: Returns the NVIDIA Reflex mode actually applied, see [enum StreamlineReflexMode]. It can be higher than the requested [constant STREAMLINE_PARAM_REFLEX_MODE], since DLSS Frame Generation forces low latency mode while it is active. Returns [constant STREAMLINE_REFLEX_MODE_OFF] when Reflex is unavailable.

method.name: is_frame_generation_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while DLSS Frame Generation is enabled on a viewport. Frame generation starts a few frames after [member Viewport.frame_generation] is set (once Reflex runs), and is turned off temporarily while the window is resized and when the viewport is not rendered with DLSS.

method.name: set_parameter
method.description: Set various parameters related to Streamline. See [enum StreamlineParameterType] for types.

constants.constant: NVIDIA Reflex mode: [code]0.0[/code] off, [code]1.0[/code] low latency, [code]2.0[/code] low latency with boost (see [enum StreamlineReflexMode]). Overrides [member ProjectSettings.rendering/streamline/reflex_mode].
Frame rate limit done by NVIDIA Reflex, as a frame time in microseconds ([code]0[/code] = no limit). Overrides [member ProjectSettings.rendering/streamline/reflex_frame_limit_us].
The default DLSS preset to use, as a one-letter [String]. Overrides [member ProjectSettings.rendering/streamline/dlss_preset]. Valid values: ?,F,G,H,I,J,K,L,M,N,O
The default DLSS Ray Reconstruction preset to use. Not supported in this build (ignored).

Number of frames DLSS Frame Generation generates per rendered frame, [code]1[/code] to [code]3[/code] (2x to 4x). Values above [method get_frame_generation_max_frames] are clamped. Overrides [member ProjectSettings.rendering/streamline/frame_generation_frames].
Whether Streamline reports that NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution / DLAA is supported.

Whether NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation can be used: Streamline reports it as supported (RTX 40 series or newer, hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling enabled, recent driver) and Reflex and PCL are available too. Always [code]false[/code] in the editor.
Whether Streamline reports that NVIDIA DLSS Ray Reconstruction is supported. Always [code]false[/code] in this build.
Whether Streamline reports that NVIDIA Image Scaling is supported. Always [code]false[/code] in this build.
Whether Streamline reports that NVIDIA Reflex low latency mode is supported. Always [code]false[/code] in the editor.
Whether Streamline reports that PC Latency (PCL) markers are supported. Always [code]false[/code] in the editor.
NVIDIA Reflex low latency mode with boost (keeps GPU clocks high).
